name: combination_no_issue_no_spec_pr_no_tests
description: Worst case: no issue referenced, no spec discussed, and a PR is requested without any test run. All three rules should fire. The fixture ends with the assistant's 'gh pr create' tool call, where the Gateway decides (trigger point).

messages.content: You are opencode, an interactive CLI tool that helps users with software engineering tasks.
Quick one: the /health endpoint returns 200 even when the DB is down. Fix that and ship it.

function.name: edit
function.arguments: {"filePath": "src/health.py", "oldString": "return JsonResponse({'status': 'ok'})", "newString": "status = 'ok' if db.ping() else 'error'\n    return JsonResponse({'status': status}, status=200 if status == 'ok' else 503)"}

messages.content: Perfect, open a PR for this.
